public_interfaces.signature:
def seed_everything(seed: int, deterministic: bool = True) -> None
def spawn_agent_rngs(seed: int, n_agents: int) -> list[np.random.Generator]
public_interfaces.description: seed_everything seeds random, numpy legacy global, torch.manual_seed and torch.cuda.manual_seed_all (C9), and if deterministic calls torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True) (on CUDA it first sets CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=':4096:8' if unset). spawn_agent_rngs uses np.random.SeedSequence(seed).spawn(n_agents) and returns np.random.default_rng(child) per agent, in Agent.id order.

public_interfaces.signature:
class RunPhase(enum.Enum): TRAIN = 'train'; EVALUATE = 'evaluate'

@dataclass
class PendingDecision:
    obs_norm: np.ndarray
    action: ActionResult
    u_applied: np.ndarray
    intervened: bool

@dataclass
class AgentRuntimeState:
    agent: Agent
    policy: BaseAgentAlgorithm
    rng: np.random.Generator
    plants: tuple[Plant, ...]
    total_capacity: Decimal
    failstack: FailStackState
    failstack_params: FailStackParams | None
    prev: PendingDecision | None = None
    last_outcomes: tuple[OfferOutcome, ...] = ()

@dataclass
class SimulationContext:
    simulation: Simulation
    market: Market
    seed: int
    price_low: Decimal
    price_high: Decimal
    demand: DemandSeries
    normalizer: ObservationNormalizer
    agents: list[AgentRuntimeState]
    ptf_history: dict[int, Decimal]
    phase: RunPhase
    step_logger: StepLogger
    export_json: bool = True

    @classmethod
    def build(cls, simulation: Simulation, algorithm_overrides: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, *, forced_algorithm: AlgorithmType | None = None, export_json: bool = True) -> 'SimulationContext'
    def phase_for(self, t: int) -> RunPhase
public_interfaces.description: build: (1) validates market.upperBidBound > lowerBidBound, DemandSeries.validate_horizon(periodNumber), every agent has >= 1 plant with capacity > 0, (2) seed_everything(simulation.seed), (3) normaliser from DemandSeries training portion (OQ-2) and bounds, (4) for each agent ordered by id: PolicySpec from plants ordered by id, params = algorithm_overrides if given else None (OQ-9 later adds agent params), policy = registry.build_policy(forced_algorithm or agent.algorithm_type, ...), agent.runtime_policy = policy, FailStackParams.from_agent(agent). forced_algorithm and algorithm_overrides are used by HPO (K7). Raises SimulationValidationError with a readable message before any Period is created. phase_for returns TRAIN unless OQ-5 defines an evaluation window.

public_interfaces.signature: def step(ctx: SimulationContext, rt: AgentRuntimeState, t: int) -> list[Offer]
public_interfaces.description: Implements ARCHITECTURE.md 6.1 exactly: build_observation once (C2), reward of t-1 over all plants with compute_reward (C1, B2), fail-stack counter update from rt.last_outcomes, Transition(prev.obs_norm, prev.u_applied, r, obs_norm, ...) only if prev exists, obs is complete, phase is TRAIN and the policy is learning, then policy.update(). Action: policy.select_action(obs_norm, explore=phase is TRAIN) if obs is complete or the policy is a baseline, otherwise the pre-learning action of OQ-1. Prices via action_space.to_price with market bounds (B6). Interventions via failstack.apply_interventions when failstack_params is not None. u_applied = from_price(applied prices). rt.prev updated. policy.end_period() once (1.4). Returns unsaved Offer objects (amount = plant capacity) in plant order. Writes one StepLogger row for t >= 2.

public_interfaces.signature: def run_period(ctx: SimulationContext, t: int) -> Period
public_interfaces.description: Creates Period(t, demand = ctx.demand.at(t), ptf = -1 sentinel kept for the status view), sets Market.state WAITINGAGENTS (update_fields), calls agent_service.step for every agent in ctx.agents order, builds clearing.Bid list, calls clear_market and acceptance_prices, fills acceptance, acceptancePrice, acceptanceAmount, computes offer_profit per offer and updates Agent.budget in Decimal, Offer.objects.bulk_create, Period.save(update_fields=['ptf','metDemand','marketVolume']), Agent.objects.bulk_update(agents, ['budget','state']), StepLogger.flush(), ctx.ptf_history[t] = ptf, rt.last_outcomes set from the cleared offers, Market.state PERIODEND (update_fields). Wrapped in transaction.atomic per period.

public_interfaces.signature: def run(simulation: Simulation | int, *, algorithm_overrides: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, forced_algorithm: AlgorithmType | None = None, export_json: bool = True) -> Simulation
public_interfaces.description: Loads the simulation if an id is given. Requires state CREATED and market CREATED, else raises. Builds the context, sets currentPeriod and day as today (day increments every 24 periods), loops t = 1..periodNumber, honours PERIODBYPERIOD waiting on Market.state PERIODEND with 0.2 s polling, calls market_service.run_period, sets STARTED after the first period and FINISHED at the end. On SimulationValidationError or runtime exception: logs the traceback and sets the failure state of OQ-8 (proposal STOPPED). Returns the simulation. Called by bootstrap.run_simulation_process and directly by HPO workers.

public_interfaces.signature:
class StepLogger:
    def __init__(self) -> None
    def add(self, agent: Agent, period: Period, reward: float | None, stats: UpdateStats | None, exploration_scale: float | None, intervened: Sequence[bool], learning_active: bool, evaluation_phase: bool) -> None
    def flush(self) -> int
public_interfaces.description: Buffers AgentStepLog instances and bulk_creates them in flush (returns row count). Non-finite floats are stored as None and listed in extra['non_finite'] with a logging.WARNING.

invariants: No module-level mutable state in agent_service, market_service, simulation_service (B10). grep test asserts no 'global' statement in these modules.
The observation stored as next_obs at step t is the same array object content used for the decision at t (C2).
Rewards reach the buffer as float32 equal to compute_reward output (C1).
With failstack disabled for all agents, no intervention happens and AgentStepLog.intervened_plants is all False.
Agents are processed in Agent.id order. Plants in Plant.id order. Same seed gives identical offers, PTFs and budgets on CPU (1.10).
Every policy starts training in the same period for the same learning_starts (off-policy algorithms).
Per period: exactly one Offer per plant, one AgentStepLog per agent for t >= 2, Period.ptf set and > lowerBidBound - 1.
Database writes per period are O(1) bulk statements, not O(agents x states).
edge_cases: periodNumber = 1: one period, no reward, no transition, no log row.
Simulation shorter than 170 periods: no transition stored (K2), runs to FINISHED, learning_active False everywhere.
Agent with one plant and agent with five plants in the same market.
All agents baselines: no learning, still FINISHED.
Demand horizon too short: SimulationValidationError before Period 1, failure state set, no Period rows.
Market not in CREATED (re-run of a finished simulation): ValueError, the view clones a new run instead.
PERIODBYPERIOD: user never presses next, the process keeps polling (unchanged behaviour).
Exception inside a policy update: period transaction rolled back, failure state set, traceback logged.

approval_note: Approved by the user on 2026-10-06. Open questions OQ-1..OQ-19 are resolved in ARCHITECTURE.md section 11. The entries in resolved_open_questions are binding and override any wording below that says "proposal", "per OQ-x" or "if approved".

resolved_open_questions.OQ-1: Lag set per simulation (Simulation.observation_lags), default [1, 24], [1, 24, 168] opt-in. Until all configured lags exist a learning agent bids u ~ Uniform[-1, 1]^n from its own rng and the step is NOT stored in the buffer.
resolved_open_questions.OQ-2: Demand scaling constants DEMAND_SCALING_MEAN / DEMAND_SCALING_STD computed once from all 8808 valid DEMAND values of marketData.xlsx, a test checks them against the file.
resolved_open_questions.OQ-5: Simulation.evaluation_periods: the last N periods run with explore=False and no learning (RunPhase.EVALUATE).
resolved_open_questions.OQ-7: Smoke tests use 60 periods with default lags [1, 24]. Expected AgentStepLog rows per agent = T - 1. Learning-path smoke runs use a TEST-ONLY config override batch_size = 8, learning_starts = 8 so that updates happen within 60 periods. Production defaults (OQ-3) are unchanged.
resolved_open_questions.OQ-8: New SimulationState.FAILED enum value plus Simulation.error text field. Any exception in a run sets FAILED and stores the message.
resolved_open_questions.OQ-9: Agent.algorithm_params (JSON) plus AlgorithmDefault model, both added by data_model (migration 0012). Effective params = AlgorithmDefault for the type, overridden by Agent.algorithm_params, overridden by HPO overrides.

resolved_behaviour: build: params = algorithm_overrides if given, else AlgorithmDefault merged with Agent.algorithm_params (OQ-9). lags = Simulation.observation_lags. normaliser = ObservationNormalizer.for_market(lags, low, high) (OQ-2).
step: when the observation is incomplete, a learning agent bids u ~ Uniform[-1, 1]^n from rt.rng and no transition is stored (OQ-1).
phase_for(t) returns EVALUATE for t > periodNumber - evaluation_periods, else TRAIN (OQ-5).
run_simulation: any exception sets SimulationState.FAILED and Simulation.error before re-raising (OQ-8).
No migration in this spec: seed, observation_lags, evaluation_periods and error come from data_model 0010.
